paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking perturbations by tag. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations across different categories, displaying data as a series of bars with error bars representing standard deviation. The horizontal axis represents categories labeled 'case', 'gender', 'tag', 'number', and 'tense', presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled 'effect', with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels at increments of 5. Six groups of bars are present, representing different model types: mBERT-L2 (teal), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (red), mBERT-B2 (brown), and XLM-B2 (maroon). Within each category, the bars representing the six models are arranged side by side. The shortest bar, representing XLM-B2 for the 'tense' category, has an approximate value of 1; the tallest bar, representing mBERT-L2 for the 'case' category, has an approximate value of 13. Error bars extend above and below each bar, indicating the variability within each data point; for example, the error bar above the teal bar for 'case' extends to approximately 19, while the error bar below it extends to approximately 7. The bars are not sorted within each model group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
